spec_match.rationale: Reads resolved AccentColor/AccentColorText per element against the inherited and own computed accent-color — the exact own-vs-inherited distinction the WPT resolution test pins — via hidden probe children.

interactive.rationale: Two selects and a validated free-form colour input restyle a three-level tree; the table and readout re-resolve on every change.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises an inheritance-tree inspection table with validated free-form input; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers not-set/inherit chains, currentColor, auto, modern colour spaces (oklch round-trips shown), and invalid input rejected via CSS.supports with aria-invalid + explanation.

references.rationale: Links the chromestatus entry and the WPT resolution test alongside sibling concepts.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite asserts own and inherited mirroring plus live updates — the exact contracts this table visualises; all can fail (and do on Chromium 141).

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP-driven: branch select change re-resolved the chain, oklch leaf value accepted and shown, invalid value rejected with aria-invalid=true and explanatory readout, console clean, both viewports screenshot-verified; the keyword columns can only show 'not parsed' here, so the resolving tiers await Chrome 158.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the probe tier (fallback labelled) and, on the follows tier, that resolved AccentColor equals computed accent-color per element.

design_system.rationale: Table, selects and readout use design-system variables throughout; colour dots render dynamic resolved values without carrying text.

accessibility.rationale: Native selects and text input with visible labels and aria-describedby hint; semantic table with caption and th scopes; the horizontally scrollable table wrapper is a focusable labelled region; single polite readout.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No page-level horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3 (table scrolls inside its labelled wrapper by design); controls stack full-width; both classes screenshot-verified.

openQuestions.title: Verify resolving columns on real Chrome 158+/Canary
openQuestions.detail: On this container's Chromium 141 the keyword columns honestly report 'not parsed'; the live resolution behaviour (columns tracking each select change, static-tier constancy on flagged pre-158 builds) needs a run on Chrome 158/Canary to confirm the table matches the WPT values.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Table semantics and the scrollable region pattern were built to spec, but chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable, so the accessibility tree (caption/row-header exposure, region label) was not inspected per project rule 7b.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table on narrow mobile viewport without page overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Contain wide data tables in a scrollable region rather than letting the page overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The table lives in .tablewrap with overflow-x auto, tabindex=0 and role=region aria-label noting the horizontal scroll; the page itself never exceeds the viewport.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: scrollWidth === innerWidth at 360×740; /tmp/claude-0/agentA/table_m_inspector.png shows the contained scroll.

guidanceConsulted.query: validating free-form input and announcing errors accessibly
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce dynamic errors via a live region and reflect state with aria-invalid; keep one polite region per page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Invalid colours set aria-invalid=true and the single role=status readout explains CSS.supports rejected the value without applying it.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP: set leaf input to 'notacolor!!' → aria-invalid=true and readout explanation observed.

guidanceConsulted.query: stacking labelled form controls on small screens
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let controls take full width on narrow containers via auto-fit minmax grids.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The three level controls use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 14rem), 1fr)) and inline-size: 100% inputs.

summary: Inspection tool verified on Chromium 141 headless: selects and the validated free-form input drive real accent-color changes down the tree, computed accent-color column live, keyword columns honestly 'not parsed', invalid input rejected accessibly, console clean, both viewports verified. Resolving-tier output needs a Chrome 158 pass.
